experiment: ECC_MINBLOCKS=2 versus 3 with all other native control flags unchanged
hypothesis: A tighter register budget may increase resident warps and hide instruction latency. The 104-register control and nsys timeline motivate an experiment but do not establish a bottleneck.
order: control/candidate on even-indexed pairs, candidate/control on odd-indexed pairs
correctness: Both binaries pass GPU arithmetic/storage/shared-sigma and checkpoint/restart integration. Cross-binary checkpoints agree for 8,128,257 workers. Every DP34 sample has the same sorted DP multiset; all completed update counts match, zero dropped reports.
premeasurementAbandonment: Stop if resident blocks do not increase or the candidate has nonzero stack/local bytes; no lengthy timing run in either case.
acceptance: At least 1% median speedup and lower endpoint >1 of a two-sided 95% Student-t interval for mean paired log ratios (df=4), on both workloads. This is exploratory five-pair evidence assuming independent approximately normal log ratios, not an assumption-free guarantee.
goal: One RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition reaches >=28B/s benchmark median with no DP34 regression. G7 RTX PRO 4500 results remain separate.
defaultChange: No automatic promotion or production preset change.
cloudLimit: One benchmark GPU; 45-minute workload, 50-minute controller, independent 55-minute shutdown, exact-ID termination.
